themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Multiple far-right leaders across Europe and the Americas are confronting legal troubles and political setbacks, from Marine Le Pen's conviction in France to Nigel Farage's financial investigations in the UK. These challenges are reshaping their political strategies and public perception ahead of key elections.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen convicted of embezzlement but allowed to run for president in 2027, sparking debates on judicial influence in politics.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage resigns as MP amid financial investigations, triggering a by-election and raising questions about political accountability.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox faces internal turmoil and legal scrutiny, including investigations into party officials for conflicts of interest and misuse of public funds.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Giorgia Meloni and Matteo Salvini navigate legal and political pressures, including Salvini's citizenship law proposals and Meloni's diplomatic tensions with Trump.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government faces corruption allegations and internal divisions, with key officials resigning amid scandals.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS politicians face investigations and public backlash over healthcare mismanagement and historical disputes with Ukraine.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni feud escalates ahead of NATO summit
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with public snubs and disagreements over military alliances and foreign policy. This feud highlights broader transatlantic tensions and the challenges of maintaining Western unity.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump publicly criticizes Meloni over Italy's stance on Iran and military base access, escalating tensions ahead of the NATO summit.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni defends her diplomatic approach, emphasizing Italy's sovereignty and NATO commitments despite Trump's criticism.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: UK media and politicians react to the Trump-Meloni feud, framing it as a broader challenge to Western unity and NATO cohesion.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leader Santiago Abascal shifts stance on Trump, criticizing his treatment of allies and highlighting the diplomatic fallout.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: French far-right media and politicians comment on the Trump-Meloni feud, using it to critique EU-US relations.

themes.title: Milei’s ‘shutdown’ policy sparks global right-wing emulation
themes.blurb: Javier Milei's proposal to implement a U.S.-style government shutdown in Argentina has resonated with right-wing leaders worldwide, who see it as a model for fiscal austerity and limiting state intervention. This policy debate reflects a broader push for economic reforms among conservative governments.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei proposes a 'shutdown' law to halt government spending when the budget is exhausted, aiming to enforce fiscal discipline.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: U.S. conservatives and media outlets praise Milei's shutdown proposal as a model for fiscal responsibility and limiting government overreach.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leaders express support for Milei's economic policies, framing them as a blueprint for Spain's fiscal reforms and deregulation efforts.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing politicians and economists discuss Milei's shutdown policy as a potential model for Italy's economic challenges.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD leaders highlight Milei's shutdown proposal as an example of how Germany could implement similar austerity measures.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, proposing stricter citizenship laws, deportations, and border controls. These parallel efforts reflect a shared strategy to address voter concerns over migration and national identity.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox proposes stricter immigration controls, including deportations and opposition to mosque constructions, framing immigration as a threat to national cohesion.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia fast-track laws to revoke citizenship for serious crimes and automatically deport convicted non-EU immigrants.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen's campaign emphasizes stricter immigration controls, including opposition to 'Islamization' and support for national priority policies.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD proposes stricter immigration policies, including deportations and opposition to multiculturalism, as part of its electoral platform.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP advocates for stricter immigration policies, including opposition to multiculturalism and support for deportations of criminal immigrants.

themes.title: Public media crackdowns fuel far-right backlash
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and leaders are reacting strongly to perceived crackdowns on public media, framing these actions as attacks on free speech and political dissent. This theme highlights the growing polarization over media independence and government influence.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Hungary's new government suspends state media broadcasts, sparking accusations of censorship and political interference from far-right factions.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS politicians criticize public media reforms, framing them as politically motivated attacks on conservative voices.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox accuses public broadcasters of bias, demanding greater representation and threatening to defund media outlets perceived as hostile.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: AfD protests against perceived media bias, framing public media reforms as attacks on free speech and conservative viewpoints.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN leaders criticize public media for alleged left-wing bias, calling for reforms to ensure balanced representation of far-right perspectives.
